# `theme`

Colours and styles by name, border characters, a font and the engine's marks (12 §4.3).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `colors` (object, name → string; optional): Colours by name. Each value is `#rrggbb` or the name of another colour. A name that is also a `color` definition overrides that definition's `rgb`.
- `styles` (object, name → object [`StyleDef`](#styledef); optional): Styles by name, used by widgets' `style` and by inline tags.
- `borders` (object [`BordersDef`](#bordersdef); optional): The characters borders are drawn with.
- `font` (object [`FontDef`](#fontdef), or `null`; optional): The font for a window frontend.
- `marks` (object, name → object [`GlyphDef`](#glyphdef); optional): The glyphs the engine draws for itself, by name: the marks of the world view (a pile of items, a suspected presence, something only heard, a capsized vessel) and the parts of widgets (see `crate::ui`).

<a id="styledef"></a>
### `StyleDef`

A style in a theme: colours and attributes applied over whatever is beneath. Anything left out is left as it was.

- `fg` (string, or `null`; optional): The colour of the characters: a colour name or `#rrggbb`.
- `bg` (string, or `null`; optional): The colour behind them: a colour name or `#rrggbb`.
- `bold` (`true` or `false`, or `null`; optional): Bold on (`true`) or off (`false`).
- `dim` (`true` or `false`, or `null`; optional): Dim on or off.
- `italic` (`true` or `false`, or `null`; optional): Italic on or off.
- `underline` (`true` or `false`, or `null`; optional): Underline on or off.
- `reverse` (`true` or `false`, or `null`; optional): Exchange foreground and background, on or off.

<a id="bordersdef"></a>
### `BordersDef`

The characters borders are drawn with. Any left out keeps the engine's default line-drawing character.

- `h` (one character, or `null`; optional): Horizontal edge.
- `v` (one character, or `null`; optional): Vertical edge.
- `tl` (one character, or `null`; optional): Top-left corner.
- `tr` (one character, or `null`; optional): Top-right corner.
- `bl` (one character, or `null`; optional): Bottom-left corner.
- `br` (one character, or `null`; optional): Bottom-right corner.

<a id="fontdef"></a>
### `FontDef`

The font a window frontend draws with. The terminal frontend ignores it.

- `file` (string; **required**): The font file, relative to the mod's directory.
- `size` (whole number, 0 or more; **required**): The size of a glyph cell's height in pixels.

<a id="glyphdef"></a>
### `GlyphDef`

A `glyph` as a definition writes it (12 §4.1).

- `ch` (one character, or `null`; optional): The character: one Unicode character of single width. Required unless `shape` is given.
- `fg` (string, or `null`; optional): The colour of the character: a colour name, `#rrggbb`, `"material"`, `"own"` or `"dress"`. Left out, the theme's text colour.
- `bg` (string, or `null`; optional): The colour behind the character, written like `fg`. `null` or left out: whatever is beneath.
- `bold` (`true` or `false`, or `null`; optional): Whether the character is drawn bold.
- `by_state` (object, name → object [`GlyphPartDef`](#glyphpartdef); optional): Parts replaced while the element is in a named state.
- `by_level` (list of object [`GlyphPartDef`](#glyphpartdef); optional): Parts replaced by field or damage level: entry 0 for level 0, and so on. A level past the end uses the last entry.
- `shape` (object, one of `"north"`, `"east"`, `"south"`, `"west"` ([`Facing`](#facing)) → list of string; optional): For a thing that fills several cells: rows of characters, one per cell of its footprint, for a facing. Facings not given are turned from the first one that is.
- `layer` (whole number; optional): Drawn over (positive) or under (negative) its usual place in the order of 12 §6.1.

<a id="glyphpartdef"></a>
### `GlyphPartDef`

The parts of a glyph that a state, a level or a look can replace.

- `ch` (one character, or `null`; optional): The character: one Unicode character of single width.
- `fg` (string, or `null`; optional): The colour of the character.
- `bg` (string, or `null`; optional): The colour behind it. `null` or left out: whatever is beneath.
- `bold` (`true` or `false`, or `null`; optional): Whether the character is drawn bold.

<a id="facing"></a>
### `Facing`

A direction a thing of several cells can face.

One of:

- `"north"`: Toward the top of the map.
- `"east"`: Toward the right.
- `"south"`: Toward the bottom.
- `"west"`: Toward the left.
